mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.name FROM base_task b WHERE b.org_id = #{orgId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND (b.status = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM item_task_node n JOIN project p ON p.id = n.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN item i ON i.id = n.item_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE n.base_task_id = b.id AND n.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.org_id = #{orgId} )) ORDER BY b.name, b.id
